formula: (OMIE + 0.004 + 0.010 + TSE)*1.16 + TAR_BTN_bi + 0.001; EUR/kWh pre-VAT; TSE=0.002893 from April 1 retrospectively; zero MIBEL
tariff: Common reference, variable energy only; excludes fixed charges, VAT and audiovisual/DGEG fees. Not a reconstruction of an individual bill. Negative prices preserved.

carbon.method: Fixed 2023 APA-calibrated fossil coefficient; actual 2024 REN generation and daily REE imports; delivery multiplier 1.16. Derived operational estimate, not an APA-certified 2024 factor or marginal emissions.

weather: PVGIS6 SARAH-3 hourly horizontal irradiation; ERA5 temperature, humidity and wind via Open-Meteo; 38.72N -9.14E. 15-minute values interpolated, night masked astronomically; no fabricated weather noise.
eredes: Published chronological local interval ends (92/100 slots on DST transition days), aligned by row order to UTC after checking every civil date. Profile is a synthetic demand prior, not measured household consumption.
forecast: Causal persistence for weather; published day-ahead OMIE (14:00 Madrid cutoff), prior-day fallback; retroactive TSE excluded until May 1 publication known.

forecast_support.scope: Market forecast targets only; meteorological persistence already uses full horizons. Internal native load/PV boundary clipping is unchanged.
forecast_support.contract: Same common BTN benchmark margin, CGS, losses and IEC; future TAR/TSE known from ERSE announcements of 16 and 20 December 2024.
